Minimal preset preserves nav, footer, aside

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"preprocessing\":{\"preset\":\"Minimal\"}}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<nav>Navigation</nav><p>Content</p><footer>Footer</footer>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
